test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
If there is an error in the given sentence, choose the correct answer from the options without changing the tense. One of the four options has the same response as the original sentence, which can be chosen in case of agreement with the original sentence.

I will have been studying English for three years by the end of this course.

options.text: I have been studying English for three years by the end of this course.
I will have been studying English for three years by the end of this course.
I had been studying English for three years by the end of this course.
I was studying English for three years by the end of this course.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence structure is correct and uses the future perfect continuous tense appropriately.
 
• The phrase "I will have been studying" indicates an ongoing action that will be completed by a specific future time.
 
• The duration of "three years" is accurately placed to show the length of time by the end of the course.
 
• There is no grammatical error in the original sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I will have been studying English for three years by the end of this course."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "I have been studying English for three years by the end of this course,"** – This option incorrectly uses the present perfect continuous tense instead of the future perfect continuous tense.
 
• **Option 3: "I had been studying English for three years by the end of this course,"** – This option incorrectly uses the past perfect continuous tense instead of the future perfect continuous tense.
 
• **Option 4: "I was studying English for three years by the end of this course,"** – This option incorrectly uses the past continuous tense instead of the future perfect continuous tense.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, which is true in this case.

``
